    • isExplicitModel

      public static boolean isExplicitModel(File file, joptsimple.OptionSet options) throws IOException
      Whether a model file is an explicit model, to be read by ToAst rather than compiled by clafer: given with --explicit, or a .cfr file whose first line is AstPrinter.ExplicitHeader (or another //# OPTIONS line with --explicit).
      Throws:
      IOException

    • readModel

      public static JavascriptFile readModel(File file, joptsimple.OptionSet options) throws Exception
      Reads a model: an explicit model with ToAst, another .cfr model with Frontend, otherwise a .js file. An explicit model starts from the default scope (its scopes are in its scope file, see resolveScopes(File, JavascriptFile, OptionSet)).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - with the diagnostics, if the explicit model has errors
      Frontend.ModelException - with the errors, if the .cfr model has errors
      Exception
